task: T034 legacy display resize performance evidence

before.implementation: serial bicubic passes and palette scans; usize nearest-index buffers

after.implementation: bicubic passes and palette scans use a bounded pool of at most 4 Rayon workers; nearest-index buffers use u8; zero-color classification omits unused nearest indices

limitations: The before result is a single debug-profile sample; this is not a p95 claim.
The measurement covers local legacy display transformation only, not source discovery, network acquisition, or CLI startup.
Exact pixel parity remains the acceptance criterion; performance does not close the OpenCV inpaint or science coverage gaps.
